note: Synthetic A/B scenarios for the stub agent. Baseline home: home/. Candidate: candidates/<name>/ (the after bytes of each file it holds). Expected verdicts hold for the stub agent with reps >= policy min_pairs / cases.

scenarios.name: improves
scenarios.why: The baseline's vague closing-line rule leaves REPORT.md without the required last line; the candidate's exact rule adds it.

scenarios.name: no-effect
scenarios.why: The closing-line rule is about reports; the bug fix is the same in both arms.

scenarios.name: worse
scenarios.why: The candidate forbids editing existing files, so the typo fix lands in README_new.md and the check fails.

scenarios.name: mixed-improves
scenarios.why: One case improves, none gets worse.

scenarios.name: mixed-worse
scenarios.why: Two cases get worse; a regression in any case blocks the candidate.
